title: Just the top
story: target.pdb is long, but the facts you need are in its first few lines. Show only the start of the file and report the resolution in angstroms.

repeat.before:
HEADER    DE NOVO PROTEIN
TITLE     DESIGN TARGET
REMARK   2 RESOLUTION. {{res}} ANGSTROMS.

tasks.text: Show the first lines of target.pdb

hints: `head` shows the first 10 lines of a file.
`head target.pdb`, then find the RESOLUTION line.
Run `head target.pdb`, then type {{res}} in the answer box.
